summary: Short kerb on a bend of a quiet street, homes 12 m away.

best_section.where: Bend in Greenlaw Street beside the garden island

drivers.seclusion: Houses 12 m away on each side, with a pool house and gardens close by.

drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, local traffic only.

flags: Tight bend limits room to pull in
